title: Boss Rush: every boss, back to back
description: A new mode next to Free Run and the Daily: the bosses of all four maps in a row with a short breather and a level-up between each, its own board label and its own missions.

title: Evolve everything + a Collection
description: Part 1 of a full evolution table: every base weapon gets an evolution with its own art and effect, the level-up card says what it will become, and a Collection screen shows everything you've seen.

title: Play as The Miner
description: A fourth character, unlocked in the Market: a hard-hat bear-buster whose pickaxe cracks grizzly shields, built for the grizzlies and rug pullers that ended 44% of yesterday's runs.
